method: seed_sentence(id, seed) -> CosyVoice2 speed=1.0 raw PCM -> trim 70ms + fade 30ms -> normal MP3; slow = same PCM + atempo=0.8
selection: Paraformer-zh and SenseVoiceSmall on both speeds: no syllable both models get wrong, first syllable right for both; lowest toneless-pinyin edit distance. 0087/0869/2887 chosen by maintainer listening.
screening: Full local ASR of 11,154 advanced MP3s flagged 137 sentences where both models erred on the same syllable; 133 replaced, 4 kept (ASR text variants, see advanced-listening-review.md).
